titleEn: Tech Talk: Satshot on AI-Enhanced Satellite Imagery
titleZh: Tech Talk：Satshot 谈 AI 增强卫星影像
summaryZh: Satshot 推出基于 AI 的 Super Resolution 技术，可将广泛可得的卫星影像增强至 1 米分辨率，帮助农艺师和种植者识别田间变异性、作物损害、施用问题及管理分区。该技术无需依赖飞机或无人机，即可在全球范围内支持作物巡查、变量施肥、作物保险调查和农艺决策，揭示传统遥感方法可能遗漏的模式。
featuredReason: 该技术展示了 AI 增强卫星影像在农业中的实际应用，虽主要面向大田作物，但其高分辨率遥感分析方法对智慧畜牧中的牧场管理、饲料作物监测和养殖场环境评估具有跨领域参考价值。
contentFull:
By CropLife 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 How can AI-enhanced satellite imagery give agronomists and growers a clearer view of what’s happening in their fields without relying on aircraft or drones? In this 2026 Tech Talk, Lanny Faleide of SatShot introduces the company’s new Super Resolution technology, which uses advanced AI-powered processing to enhance widely available satellite imagery to a 1-meter resolution. Learn how this breakthrough helps users identify field variability, crop damage, application issues, and management zones with unprecedented detail from virtually anywhere in the world. Discover how high-resolution satellite analytics can support crop scouting, variable-rate management, crop insurance investigations, and agronomic decision-making by revealing patterns that traditional remote sensing methods may miss.
